entry.title: New: Resolution 569 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 569-26 & FC-152 - 06/03/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS FROM LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR WAREHOUSE SPACE TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year lease agreement with Geo Investment Company, Inc., for warehouse space located at 73-4081 Hulikoa Drive, with an initial security deposit of $4,896, and an estimated monthly cost of approximately $3,240 for the first year and increasing thereafter.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 569-26 & FC-152 - 06/03/26
